tools.name: check_site
tools.description: Check a site's AI search visibility: which AI crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot and more) robots.txt allows, whether the homepage ships readable text without JavaScript, and whether an llms.txt exists.

url.description: A site to check, e.g. example.com or https://example.com

tools.name: generate_llms_txt
tools.description: Generate an llms.txt file from a site's real pages and sitemap.

url.description: A site to generate an llms.txt for

credit.description: Include a one-line attribution back to this tool. Default true.

tools.name: validate_llms_txt
tools.description: Validate an existing llms.txt against the spec.

url.description: A site whose /llms.txt should be fetched and validated

tools.name: lint_robots_txt
tools.description: Lint a robots.txt for AI-crawler-specific mistakes. Pass url to fetch it live, or robots_txt to lint pasted text directly.

url.description: A site whose /robots.txt should be fetched and linted

robots_txt.description: Raw robots.txt text to lint directly, instead of fetching url
